name: Crab Rescue 2
author: gparnold
description:
Save the Crabs.

Jump around the island reefs, collecting crabs as you go. But beware of the islands evil cannon will follow your every move, trying to break you apart and stop your rescue attempt.

Skull Rock looms in the distance. The cannons destructive nemesis lurks within. Can you get there and destroy the evil cannon before it gets you?

Finally escape the island with all 8 crabs.

Can you rescue them all?
